item.title: Patch now (update): Broadcom VMware vCenter: Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel
item.description:
Broadcom VMware vCenter: Authentication bypass · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200, 8.0 U3m · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Update Broadcom VMware vCenter to the fixed version for your release line (for example 9.1.1.0200, 9.0.2.0200 or 8.0 U3m).

Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-123890
